mapper.select: SELECT t.`id`, t.`spot_id`, t.`title`, t.`sub_title`, t.`rules`, t.`pay_value`, t.`actual_value`, t.`type`, t.`status`, lt.`stock`, lt.begin_time, lt.end_time FROM cg_ticket t LEFT JOIN cg_limited_performance_ticket lt ON t.id = lt.ticket_id WHERE t.spot_id = #{spotId} AND t.status = 1
